description: Passes a sixteen-channel polyphonic gate signal through, dropping gates step by step at a probability set per channel and per step

params.text: Picks which of the sixteen channels the PERCENTAGE knob edits
Picks which of the sixteen steps the PERCENTAGE knob edits, numbered 1 to 16
Sets the chance that the gate is passed at the chosen channel and step, from 0 to 100 percent; turning either of the other two knobs loads the stored value for the new place

inputs.text: The polyphonic gate signal to be thinned out, one channel per drum part
A rising edge advances the sequence one step, wrapping round after sixteen; clocks arriving within 1ms of a reset are ignored
A rising edge returns the sequence to its first step

outputs.text: The polyphonic gate signal with the dropped gates removed, sixteen channels; a channel that does not pass holds its last voltage until the next step

notes: every channel and every step starts at 100 percent, so gates pass through unchanged until a percentage is lowered

inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
